message.text: The voice app's file and shell tools (read, write, edit, list, glob, shell) are merged and start working at the next Servex restart (Servex/ext/remote/doc/remote-tools.md). create_page no longer edits page.js, and /live can now open a child listed only in its page.jsonl. The subpages helper is now writing up the two ways to store a child page.
